description: This PHP class defines a data model for representing claim expense information in an HR management system. It utilizes annotations for API schema documentation and includes methods to initialize the model with entity data, specifically ClaimExpense entities.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseModel
classes.description: A model class representing claim expense data with schema annotations for API documentation, designed for serialization and normalization within the HRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ClaimExpenseModel object with data from a ClaimExpense entity and configures filtering and attribute mappings for serialization.
